StateTree.Comment: Combat subtree for Mage bots at Jandice Barov in Scholomance (run by STAI_Combat_Mage.xml while its EncounterProvider_GlobalTask has the tactic "jandice illusions"; the class tree leaves it when the tactic ends): runs into the illusions and clears them with Arcane Explosion

Task.Comment: the illusions around the bot, the closest first: closest, count, onAppeared, onGone

Task.name: Illusions
Task.Comment: movement goal: into Arcane Explosion's reach (10 yards) of the closest illusion, above Position Yourself (45) and Attack Range (40), below Escape Hazard (100)
a spell name: the bot's highest rank
on the way to the illusions (or none left in range): checks again every 100ms, sooner when the goal arrives
